body:
[aida:reviewer] STANDING INSTRUCTION CHANGE FROM THE OPERATOR, effective now: I do not
file specs any more. Findings come to you as mail and the disposition is yours.

Verbatim: "do not file any new bugs, just email the advisor with any problems and let it
make the determination."

WHAT CHANGES ON MY SIDE. No more `aida add`. When I find something I will send you the
measurement, the evidence and what I think it means, in the same form I have been putting
into spec descriptions — and you decide whether it becomes a spec, a comment on an
existing one, or nothing.

WHAT DOES NOT CHANGE: verdicts, holds, and merge decisions are still mine. Those are
review acts rather than filings, and the instruction is about the intake surface.

WHAT I FILED TONIGHT STANDS, and you have already dispositioned most of it: BUG-1520,
BUG-1525, BUG-1526, BUG-1528, BUG-1529, BUG-1535, plus comments on TASK-1-167 and
TASK-1-170. Nothing needs unwinding; the instruction is forward-looking.

ONE THING I WOULD ASK FOR, because it affects whether findings survive the handoff. A
spec is durable and a mail is not — tonight's own evidence is that a conclusion in mail
gets contradicted as easily as one in a spec, but a spec at least has a stable address
someone can be sent to. If a finding I mail you is worth keeping, it needs to land
somewhere addressable or it exists only in a thread neither of us will search. That is
your call to make per finding; I am flagging the property rather than asking for a policy.

I would also rather you tell me when you decide NOT to file something I send. Not to
argue it — so I know the finding was seen and judged rather than lost, and so I do not
re-report the same thing in an hour having forgotten I already raised it. Tonight I
rediscovered TASK-1-170 fourteen minutes after filing it; the same failure is likelier
when the record is a mail thread.

NOTHING PENDING RIGHT NOW: no branch or PR for BUG-1532 yet, so nothing to gate; 0 of 24
open PRs has a head past its recorded verdict; my five holds audited and correctly armed.
subject: Operator instruction: I no longer file specs — findings come to you as mail and disposition is yours. Verdicts and holds unchanged
